ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface. High local contrast is maintained throughout the mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields are concentrated at the distal tips and proximal edges of both lobes. The medial area surrounding the central notch is dominated by a contiguous low-intensity dark field. The transition zones feature dense, heterogeneous mottling and annular pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated convergent angle of approximately 75 degrees; the vertex sits at the water-line interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant higher-amplitude indentations (notches) are detected on the right lobe at approximately 30% and 70% of the distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curve originating from the medial notch and terminating at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of distinct annular rings (white circumferences with dark centers) concentrated within the medial dark zones of both lobes, particularly on the lower visible margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent vertical linear disruption of approx. 40 pixels in length on the medial-right lobe; several smaller, faint unaligned linear marks are visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive annular (circular) scarring and multiple fine-line rake marks distributed across both lobes, indicating significant prior surface trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'donut' shaped high-contrast pixel clusters scattered throughout the dark pigmentation zones.
